Dear Journal,

Today I witnessed something that challenges everything we thought we knew about

life and mortality. In a small village nestled deep within the mountains of our homeland, an ancient ceremony took place - one that has been performed for centuries. But what was different this year was not just the tradition itself but rather its context. The villagers gathered around a large stone circle, their faces adorned with intricate symbols passed down through generations. Among them stood our esteemed Elder, who spoke in a language unknown to us, his voice resonating like thunder from far away. His words carried both wisdom and fear; they instilled reverence into every heart present there. As he began recounting tales from days gone by, memories flooded back as if reliving experiences themselves. Each story held secrets waiting to be uncovered, each lesson learned invaluable when faced upon adversity or uncertainty. Yet amidst these narratives lay stark reminders of death looming over all things - sometimes imperceptibly yet inevitably coming knocking on doors unprepared. Yet despite these realities plaguing mankind since time immemorial, humanity continues striving towards greatness despite dire circumstances. It reminds me how deeply intertwined fate truly is, whether good or bad luck brings forth opportunity or disaster depending on human actions taken wisely or rashly. In conclusion, dear journal keeper, I wish you well until next chapter unfolds. With love & respect,
Chronicler Aria

As I stared at them for a while trying not to touch anything, one of them fell out. The bone felt heavy; it reminded me of someone who has gone through great pain before moving onto another world.

I couldn't help but wonder how long those people had been waiting here? Waiting patiently till the next day arrived just to let us know what awaited us after all these years?

What do you think about such mysterious occurrences? Any theories or explanations for what happens between now and then?
Sincerely,
